messages:
Ruth (docs): Opened a PR to refresh the zenith-13b-quant model card: update supported variants, correct sequence limits, add fresh bench numbers, and fix an SDK snippet that used generate for embeddings. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/622

Kai (ml-infra): I'll run a quick throughput pass on the A10G pool; quant-v4 changed things. Will post numbers + the exact bench command later today.

Ruth (docs): Please include the full command and non-default flags so others can reproduce.

Vik (runtime): Heads-up: zenith-13b-quant enables the tiled-attn kernel which requires runtime >= 1.18. Add a clear compatibility line so customers know older runtimes will fallback.

Sam (sdk): I saw the generate->embeddings mixup. I will replace the Python and JS examples with client.embeddings.create calls and check the TS typedefs.

Amira (product): Don't mark anything deprecated in this PR. We can recommend zenith-embed-1 for embeddings but keep language advisory. If CS needs to notify Dedicated tenants, signal separately.

Ivy (cs): We have two Dedicated tenants on zenith-13b-quant. If we change availability later, we'll need at least 60 days notice. For now advisory language is fine.

Kai (ml-infra): Quick bench results (A10G): ctx 4096, batch 1 -> 920 tok/s (old card listed 870 tok/s). Command: `bench --model zenith-13b-quant --profile quant-v4 --ctx 4096 --batch 1 --device a10g`. Logs attached to the PR comments.

Vik (runtime): Added the runtime >=1.18 note to the PR and a fallback warning: non-fused kernels will increase p95 latency ~2.5x.

Sam (sdk): Pushed the snippet replacement and a tiny link fix to the docs branch.

ci-bot: docs/linkcheck failed (1 broken anchor)

Ruth (docs): Sam, can you patch the anchor? Once CI is green I'll merge and tag CS so they can prepare messaging if needed.

Sam (sdk): Anchor fix pushed, re-run requested.

ci-bot: docs/linkcheck re-run queued by Sam (sdk)

Ruth (docs): Thanks everyone 609 merging after green CI. If any doc regressions are spotted ping this thread.
